serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.Happy
You: Where do you want to go trick and treating? We should stick to people we already know. It should be less embarrassing…
Bot: Hmmm. Maybe we should go back to the closest place?
You: Apartment house we live in? I don’t know if that’s a good idea. We hardly know anyone there-{{wi}} Landlord…
You: You can’t be serious! There’s no way he will give us anything!
Bot: We don’t know that. He gave you these decorations, right?
You: Well…
You: Let’s just say he was forced by circumstances, ok?
#bot.Expression.Sad
Bot: So…{{wi}} We can’t go?
#bot.Expression.Happy
You: Ugh! Fine!
You: Just so you remember. Whatever happens, it’s on you!
Bot: Ok!
